source_doc: Uniform Commercial Code § 1-304 (Obligation of Good Faith)
extracted_text: Every contract or duty within the Uniform Commercial Code imposes an obligation of good faith in its performance and enforcement.
axiom_summary: UCC §1-304 imposes a good-faith obligation on performance that functions in commercial contexts where the common-law bargain-consideration doctrine is relaxed (§2-209 modification, §2-205 firm offer); good faith substitutes for the policing role that consideration plays at common law.
